task_scope: Cgm 377 age-image instructions at catalog folios 68v–71v and the following physician/urine-inspection instruction at 72v; no Voynich target material accessed.

claims_used_as_catalog_claims: Date: third quarter of the 15th century.
Localization: southwest Germany, inferred by KdiH from the calendar's reference to the diocese of Constance.
One principal hand; a second hand wrote instructions for picture spaces.
KdiH lists four life ages at 68v–71v and urine inspection at 72v.
KdiH reports 87 unfilled picture spaces with painting instructions; this review natively checked only the five folios listed below.

manifest.note: Manifest canvas/image indices are scan identifiers. Folio mapping is reported separately from the KdiH folio references.
manifest.mapping_basis: The IIIF image index increments through the scan sequence. Scan 156 visibly carries manuscript folio numeral 72 (recto); scan 140 visibly carries folio numeral 64; the intervening sequence maps scans 149, 151, 153, 155, and 157 to 68v, 69v, 70v, 71v, and 72v. KdiH independently lists the age/urine-inspection content at folios 68v–72v. Image identifiers are retained so the mapping can be checked against the source.

physician_section_placement.Cgm377: Caption on 72v is above the seasonal-regimen transition verse on that same page, which says approximately “one season may be healthy … as each season requires.” The facing 72r supplies the preceding transition (`Hie merck wie sich ein mensche ye / nach dem zite sol halten`, approximate reading) and introductory year/four-natures verses. Do not attribute the 72v seasonal verse to 72r or treat the physician as necessarily introducing complexions.
physician_section_placement.Augsburg1491: The doctor-with-flask illustration on scan 172 is placed with the verse transition introducing the year’s four natures/states, before the generic complexion introduction on scan 175. Scan 178 later begins the first named complexion, “Von der ersten complexion / Sanguineus”; it is not the start of the generic introduction.
physician_section_placement.KarlsruheK2790: The physician image on institutional platform 91v is visibly placed with the red heading about human nature according to the four complexions. KdiH foliation discrepancy remains as recorded elsewhere.
physician_section_placement.consequence: The medical figure is not a fifth season, but its local textual placement varies among witnesses; do not force one fixed section boundary across them.
